refs.purpose: Cache the resolved wrapper for summarization and validation, using its confirmed tool version.
refs.trigger: After resolving the wrapper and version, if the shared cache lacks that pin.
refs.verification: Confirm add caches the resolved pin and draft-validate --concrete --strict-state --json validates its state using the same --cache-dir.

refs.purpose: At loop endstate, extract the concrete gxformat2 workflow from the fully-concretized draft — drop drafty steps, strip `_plan_*` fields, promote `class` to `GalaxyWorkflow` — and write it as the runnable `galaxy-workflow.gxwf.yml`.
refs.trigger: When [[draft-next-step]] reports `draft: false` (no remaining drafty steps).
refs.verification: Cast the skill, run the loop to endstate on an IWC-derived draft, confirm draft-extract emits a `class: GalaxyWorkflow` file that passes terminal `gxwf validate` with no `_plan_*` fields or drafty steps.

refs.purpose: Deterministically pick the next drafty step (or report no remaining work). The orchestrator owns the loop oracle so the harness reduces to `while draft: invoke skill`.
refs.trigger: At the start of every iteration, before any per-step work.
refs.verification: Cast the skill, run on a multi-step IWC-derived draft, confirm the orchestrator picks one step per call and exits when draft: false.

refs.purpose: Validate the draft and its concrete subset with --concrete --strict-state --json; skipped tool-state checks must fail the gate.
refs.trigger: After implementing or modifying the chosen step in the draft.
refs.verification: Cast the skill, exercise on an IWC-derived draft, confirm both draft-contract diagnostics and concrete-projection diagnostics route back to the step the iteration touched.

refs.purpose: Read a stock tool's cached version when the step plan has no version pin.
refs.trigger: In step 2, when the chosen step's tool is a bare/stock id and its concrete version isn't already known from a step-plan pin.
refs.verification: Cast the skill, populate a cache with a stock tool, run list --json, confirm the reported version is what add's --tool-version uses for that bare id.

refs.purpose: Classify [[draft-validate]] diagnostics against wrapper-defined runtime failure semantics so the iteration routes back to the right authoring surface (implementation vs. wrapper choice).
refs.trigger: When draft-validate fails after a step has been implemented, or when a selected wrapper has explicit failure semantics that may surface at runtime.

refs.purpose: Read the ledger after each step implementation for a newly appended blocking entry, count the open blocking entries the convergence gate reads, and maintain the topology_repair escalation budget the loop's termination guard depends on.
refs.verification: Promote after a run where a blocking entry appended by implement is detected here and drives an escalation that strictly reduces the open count.

refs.purpose: Bind the chosen step against the deterministic tool summary manifest emitted by [[summarize-galaxy-tool]] — read `parsed_tool` for ports/datatypes and `input_schemas.workflow_step_linked` for valid step `state` shape.
refs.trigger: After a wrapper has been resolved for the chosen step and before implementing it.

refs.purpose: In/out contract: the draft this Mold reads and mutates one step per iteration conforms to [[galaxy-workflow-draft]]. Cast bundles the JSON Schema alongside the [[draft-validate]] CLI checks.

produces.description: Same draft with one additional step concretized (one loop iteration). Once every step is concrete, [[draft-next-step]] reports `draft: false` and the harness exits the loop.

Concrete gxformat2 workflow (`class: GalaxyWorkflow`) extracted from the fully-concretized draft at loop endstate via [[draft-extract]]: drafty steps dropped, `_plan_*` planning fields stripped, class promoted. The runnable, testable artifact that downstream Molds ([[implement-galaxy-workflow-test]], [[validate-galaxy-workflow]], [[run-workflow-test]]) consume.
Carried obligations ledger re-emitted by this step: entries it appended or closed updated, every other entry passed through with its provenance intact.

consumes.description: gxformat2 draft (see [[galaxy-workflow-draft-format]]) mutated in-place across iterations; topology is fully concrete, individual tool steps may still carry `TODO_*` sentinels and `_plan_*` planning fields.
Carried obligations ledger [[open-requirements-ledger]]: the run's open, resolved, and surrendered entries with their provenance. Absent on the first Mold of a run; start an empty one.
